objective.text: Detect a forbidden domain-to-HTTP dependency with a targeted architecture boundary check.

difficulty.rationale: Test a dependency rule directly rather than infer architecture from successful behavior.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The agreed rule forbids App\Domain from depending on Illuminate\Http. A new domain service adds a constructor parameter typed Illuminate\Http\Request.

stem: Which regression check targets the violated rule?

options.text: A feature test asserting that the service’s HTTP endpoint returns 200.
options.rationale: A successful endpoint does not prove that domain code is independent of HTTP types.
options.misconception: A successful endpoint does not prove that domain code is independent of HTTP types.

options.text: A dependency-boundary test that rejects Illuminate\Http references from App\Domain.
options.rationale: The rule concerns dependency direction; a targeted architecture check detects the forbidden reference even when behavior still passes.

options.text: A test counting how many routes call the service.
options.rationale: Call-site counts do not establish the namespace dependency rule.
options.misconception: Call-site counts do not establish the namespace dependency rule.

options.text: A test asserting that every domain class has the suffix Service.
options.rationale: Naming conventions do not detect forbidden type dependencies.
options.misconception: Naming conventions do not detect forbidden type dependencies.
